## Spana · salon booking and management platform

*Full-stack and mobile · bilingual (English / Arabic) · live on AWS*

A platform for beauty salons: owners manage their business, staff manage
their schedules, and customers discover salons and book through a public
salon page or the mobile app.

- **Features:** appointment booking and calendar, services and categories,
  staff management (documents, leave requests), customer accounts with OTP
  login, reviews, waitlist, notifications, reports and dashboards, support
  tickets, a platform admin console, and shareable public salon links.
- **Architecture:** a NestJS + TypeORM REST API on PostgreSQL (AWS RDS), a
  Next.js web app, a React Native (Expo) mobile app for owners, employees and
  customers, and a marketing landing page.
- **My launch work:** a launch-readiness audit of all four repositories
  (a 76-item go-live checklist); the production cut-over runbook (separate
  dev and prod environments, DNS on Route 53, TLS, AWS Amplify branches);
  research and recommendation of SMS-OTP and email providers; full
  account deletion across backend, web and mobile, as required by Google
  Play; and the English and Arabic versions of the privacy policy and terms.

::: {.chips .lg}

:::
:::

## Skinny Tax · AI tax assistant with citations

*Retrieval-augmented generation · self-hosted LLM*

A chat assistant that answers US tax questions **with citations** to the
exact passage of the law it relied on, so every answer can be checked.

- **Corpus:** the Internal Revenue Code (Title 26), Treasury Regulations and
  reference publications, plus tax rules for all 50 states collected by a
  scraping pipeline I built with Playwright (with relevance filters and
  quality audits to keep guides and statutes, not forms and archives). Users
  can also upload their own PDF, Word, Excel or text files.
- **RAG pipeline:** parse → chunk → embed → store in PostgreSQL with
  **pgvector** → retrieve → generate, with a "RAG explorer" panel showing the
  retrieved chunk behind each citation.
- **Serving:** a self-hosted **vLLM** deployment on AWS (one model for chat,
  one for embeddings, OpenAI-compatible API), an Express API on EC2 deployed
  through GitHub Actions, and a React front end on AWS Amplify.

::: {.chips .lg}
[TypeScript]{} [React / Vite]{} [Express]{} [PostgreSQL + pgvector]{} [vLLM]{} [Playwright]{} [AWS EC2 / RDS / Amplify]{} [GitHub Actions]{}
:::
:::

## United Checkout · one-click checkout for e-commerce

*Shopify app · WooCommerce plugin · NestJS API*

A fast-checkout layer for online shops: the shopper confirms an order in a
modal with phone OTP verification and a map-based address check, instead of
the full checkout form.

- **Shopify:** an embedded Shopify app (orders, customers, fulfilments)
  with OAuth install flow and webhooks.
- **WooCommerce:** a WordPress plugin that adds the fast-checkout button to
  product, cart and checkout pages and talks to the API over AJAX.
- **Backend and admin:** a NestJS API (versioned routes, JWT auth, global
  error handling) with MongoDB storage, a React admin dashboard, deployed on
  AWS.

::: {.chips .lg}

## Punjab WASA desilting monitoring platform

*Government project · GIS · dashboards*

I led development of a province-scale monitoring platform for Punjab WASA's
2026 desilting campaign across **41 districts**: GPS-tagged field reporting
from site teams, GIS maps built with Leaflet and shapefiles, and dashboards
with district KPIs, planned-versus-achieved targets and trends.
